display.purpose: Hero headlines; one per page maximum. Negative tracking is mandatory at this size.

label.purpose: Captions, metadata, button text, nav links. Slight positive tracking.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Optional, applied with translateY(-2px) to interactive cards on hover.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions. Exponential ease-out, no bounce.

components.name: Text Link CTA
components.description: The default homepage CTA. Apple-style. No background, no border.
components.css: .ds-link-cta { color: #0066cc; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -0.003em; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.25em; transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-link-cta:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-link-cta:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0, 102, 204, 0.35); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Pill Button (Primary)
components.description: Conversion-weight button. Used only for the single most important action on a page.
components.css: .ds-btn-pill { background: #0066cc; color: #fbfbfd; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 12px 22px; border-radius: 980px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-pill:hover { background: #1d1d1f; } .ds-btn-pill:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0, 102, 204, 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input with label above. Focus ring uses a colored shadow so layout never shifts.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field__label { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: #1d1d1f; } .ds-input { background: transparent; border: 1px solid #d2d2d7; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: #1d1d1f; font-family: inherit; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #86868b; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0066cc; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 102, 204, 0.25); }

narrative.northStar: Apple's restraint, on your asset budget.
narrative.overview: This system pursues the discipline of apple.com without pretending to have Apple's photography, type foundry, or brand recognition. The compromises are deliberate: Inter stands in for SF Pro, generous spacing replaces hero renders as the carrier of premium feel, and one accent color does the work that Apple's product photography normally does. The aesthetic is image-first when an image earns its place, type-first when it doesn't. Each tile picks its own theme. Restraint is the default, but restraint is not the goal: confidence is.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface family, two weights. Hierarchy through scale, not variety.
Section rhythm is asymmetric: tiles vary in height, padding, theme.
Motion budget concentrated on detail pages; shell stays calm.
CTAs are text links by default; buttons appear only where conversion friction is real.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Pure white (#fff) and pure black (#000) are prohibited site-wide. Every neutral carries a faint warm-cool tint (chroma 0.002–0.005). Even one pure-white panel breaks the system.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Persimmon (or your replacement) appears on ≤10% of any visible surface. If a page has more than one bright accent moment, demote all but the most important to Ink or Link Blue.

rules.name: The Per-Tile Theme Rule
rules.body: Theme is decided per tile, not per page. A homepage with three tiles can be light-light-dark, light-dark-light, or all-light. Tiles choose their theme by what photography or color the product needs, not by a global toggle.

rules.name: The Negative Tracking Rule
rules.body: Tracking is negative on every type role above 1.5rem. The larger the type, the more negative (display goes to -0.022em). Skipping this makes large Inter look like a free Google Font; applying it is the single highest-ROI typography move in this system.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Inter only. No serif display pairings, no mono accents, no script touches. Personality comes from weight and scale, not variety.

rules.name: The Line Length Rule
rules.body: Body text never exceeds 75ch. On large viewports, max-width: 36rem (≈576px) for prose blocks. Wider columns are unreadable regardless of font choice.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. No card has a resting shadow. Shadows exist as a response (hover, focus, floating overlay), never as decoration.

dos: Do vary tile heights and themes. A page of seven equal-height tiles is a catalog, not a story.
Do apply negative tracking to every type role above 1.5rem (-0.012em to -0.022em depending on size).
Do use Paper (#f5f5f7), never pure white.
Do prefer text-link CTAs over buttons on marketing surfaces.
Do keep the navigation bar at one weight, one color, no decoration.
Do spend the motion budget on detail pages; keep the shell calm.
Do let the background color be the tile boundary; no borders, no shadows on tiles.
donts: Don't use #fff or #000 anywhere. Always Paper / Ink.
Don't apply background-clip: text to a gradient. Solid color, weight contrast for emphasis.
Don't put icon-headline-text cards in a grid of four or six. Each tile is one product story.
Don't use ambient shadows on resting elements. Flat by default.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards, alerts, or callouts.
Don't layer glassmorphism (backdrop-filter blur) decoratively. Reserve for genuinely-floating overlays, if at all.
Don't introduce a second typeface family. Inter is the system. Weight and scale carry hierarchy.
Don't use Accent Persimmon on more than 10% of a visible surface.
Don't use em dashes in copy.
